verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is itself an official command-line environment: you type commands and press RETURN, and it ships built-in ssh, mosh, scp/sftp, curl and local Unix commands (cat, grep, ls, etc.). Nothing in the evidence ties it to AI-native or agentic use, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404. missing for 10: a CLI designed for AI or agent workflows, scriptable or non-interactive invocation an agent could drive, machine-readable output, and documentation positioning the CLI for agentic use.
